segs.pali: (15) 5. Maṅgalavaggo
1. Akusalasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 1. [[akusalasutta|不善经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi , bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi tīhi? Akusalena kāyakammena, akusalena vacīkammena, akusalena manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者，如同被带来般，投生于地狱。哪三法呢？不善的身业、不善的语业、不善的意业——诸比丘，具足这三法者，如同被带来般，投生于地狱。

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi tīhi? Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena – imehi kho , bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’’ti. Paṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者，如同被带来般，投生于天界。哪三法呢？善的身业、善的语业、善的意业——诸比丘，具足这三法者，如同被带来般，投生于天界。”第一。

segs.pali: 2. Sāvajjasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 2. [[sāvajjasutta|有罪经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi tīhi? Sāvajjena kāyakammena, sāvajjena vacīkammena, sāvajjena manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者，如同被带来般，投生于地狱。哪三法？有过失的身业、有过失的语业、有过失的意业。诸比丘，具足这三法者，如同被带来般，投生于地狱。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi tīhi? Anavajjena kāyakammena, anavajjena vacīkammena, anavajjena manokammena – imehi kho…pe… evaṃ sagge’’ti. Dutiyaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者，犹如被带来一般，投生天界。哪三法？无过失的身业、无过失的语业、无过失的意业。诸比丘，具足这三法者，犹如被带来一般，投生天界。”第二经。

segs.pali: 3. Visamasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 3. [[visamasutta|不平等经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi , bhikkhave…pe… visamena kāyakammena, visamena vacīkammena, visamena manokammena – imehi kho…pe… evaṃ niraye.
segs.zh: “诸比丘！……不平等的身业、不平等的语业、不平等的意业——诸比丘！具足这三法……如同被带来般，投生于地狱。

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi , bhikkhave, dhammehi…pe… samena kāyakammena, samena vacīkammena, samena manokammena – imehi kho…pe… evaṃ sagge’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘！具足三法……平等的身业、平等的语业、平等的意业——诸比丘！具足这三法……便如是被带往天界。”第三。

segs.pali: 4. Asucisuttaṃ
segs.zh: 4. [[asucisutta|不净经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave…pe… asucinā kāyakammena, asucinā vacīkammena, asucinā manokammena – imehi kho…pe… evaṃ niraye.
segs.zh: “诸比丘！……不净的身业、不净的语业、不净的意业——诸比丘！具足这些……如同被带来般，投生于地狱。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave…pe… sucinā kāyakammena, sucinā vacīkammena, sucinā manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’’ti. Catutthaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘！……清净的身业、清净的语业、清净的意业——诸比丘！具足这三法者，如同被带来般，投生于天界。”第四。

segs.pali: 5. Paṭhamakhatasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 5. 第一[[paṭhamakhatasutta|损坏经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati. Katamehi tīhi? Akusalena kāyakammena, akusalena vacīkammena, akusalena manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法的愚者、无能者、非善人，令自己受损、受害，有过失，为智者所呵责，并积聚众多非福。哪三种？不善的身业、不善的语业、不善的意业。诸比丘，具足这三法的愚者、无能者、非善人，令自己受损、受害，有过失，为智者所呵责，并积聚众多非福。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati. Katamehi tīhi? Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena…pe…. Pañcamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法的贤者、有能者、善人，令自己不受损、不受害，无过失，不为智者所呵责，并积聚众多福德。哪三种？善的身业、善的语业、善的意业……第五。

segs.pali: 6. Dutiyakhatasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 6. [[dutiyakhatasutta|第二掘经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave…pe… sāvajjena kāyakammena, sāvajjena vacīkammena, sāvajjena manokammena…pe….
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者……以身之有罪业、语之有罪业、意之有罪业……”

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi , bhikkhave…pe… anavajjena kāyakammena, anavajjena vacīkammena, anavajjena manokammena…pe…. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者……以身之无罪业、语之无罪业、意之无罪业……第六。”

segs.pali: 7. Tatiyakhatasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 7. [[tatiyakhatasutta|第三损坏经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave…pe… visamena kāyakammena, visamena vacīkammena, visamena manokammena…pe….
segs.zh: “诸比丘，……以不正当的身业、以不正当的语业、以不正当的意业……”

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi , bhikkhave…pe… samena kāyakammena, samena vacīkammena, samena manokammena…pe…. Sattamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，……以正当的身业、以正当的语业、以正当的意业……第七。”

segs.pali: 8. Catutthakhatasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 8. [[catutthakhatasutta|第四损坏经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave…pe… asucinā kāyakammena, asucinā vacīkammena, asucinā manokammena…pe….
segs.zh: “诸比丘，以三种……不清净的身业、不清净的语业、不清净的意业……”

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave…pe… sucinā kāyakammena, sucinā vacīkammena, sucinā manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatī’’ti. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，以三种……清净的身业、清净的语业、清净的意业——诸比丘，具足此三法者，是贤者、有能者、善人，他令自身不受损害、不受伤害，清净无过，不为智者所呵责，并生起广大福德。”第八。

segs.pali: 9. Vandanāsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 9. [[vandanāsutta|礼敬经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vandanā. Katamā tisso? Kāyena, vācāya, manasā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vandanā’’ti. Navamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，有三种礼敬。哪三种？身礼敬、语礼敬、意礼敬——诸比丘，这就是三种礼敬。”第九经。

segs.pali: 10. Pubbaṇhasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 10. [[pubbaṇhasutta|上午经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Ye , bhikkhave, sattā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti , vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, supubbaṇho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，若有众生在上午时分，以身行善，以语行善，以意行善，诸比丘，他们的上午便是善妙的。

segs.pali: ‘‘Ye, bhikkhave, sattā majjhanhikasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, sumajjhanhiko, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，凡在正午时分以身行善、以语行善、以意行善的众生，诸比丘，他们的正午便是善正午。

segs.pali: ‘‘Ye , bhikkhave, sattā sāyanhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, susāyanho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattāna’’nti.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，凡在傍晚时分以身行善、以语行善、以意行善的众生，诸比丘，他们的傍晚便是善傍晚。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suhuṭṭhitaṃ ;
segs.zh: “[[Sunakkhatta|善星]]宿、善吉祥，善黎明、善起身；

segs.pali: Sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.
segs.zh: 善时妙刻，是对梵行者们的善供奉。

segs.pali: ‘‘Padakkhiṇaṃ kāyakammaṃ, vācākammaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ;
segs.zh: “身行是善净业，语行是善净业；

segs.pali: Padakkhiṇaṃ manokammaṃ, paṇīdhi te padakkhiṇe ;
segs.zh: “意行是善净业，你的志向亦是善净圆满。”

segs.pali: Padakkhiṇāni katvāna, labhantatthe padakkhiṇe.
segs.zh: 行右绕已，于右绕中得获利益。

segs.pali: ‘‘Te atthaladdhā sukhitā, viruḷhā buddhasāsane;
segs.zh: “他们已得利益，具足安乐，于佛陀教法中增长茂盛；

segs.pali: Arogā sukhitā hotha, saha sabbehi ñātibhī’’ti. dasamaṃ;
segs.zh: 愿你们无病安乐，与一切亲眷共住。”第十经

segs.pali: Maṅgalavaggo pañcamo.
segs.zh: 吉祥品第五

segs.pali: Tassuddānaṃ –
segs.zh: 其摄颂：

segs.pali: Akusalañca sāvajjaṃ, visamāsucinā saha;
segs.zh: 不善与有过失，不正及不净；

segs.pali: Caturo khatā vandanā, pubbaṇhena ca te dasāti.
segs.zh: 掘处有四，礼敬与午前，如是合为十。

segs.pali: Tatiyo paṇṇāsako samatto.
segs.zh: 第三组五十经终
